func work() async throws {
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-swift
  let first = try await users.get(1)
  var second = await orders.get(2)
  print(first, second)
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-swift
  var third = await accounts.get(3)
  let fourth = try await records.get(4)
  print(third, fourth)
  let head = try await users.get(1)
  let tail = try await orders.many { head + 1 }
  print(head, tail)
  let left = try await users.get(1)
  let right = try await orders.each({ value in value + left })
  print(left, right)
}
